person.narrative: Happily married, both partners have good careers. Debating the timing and tradeoffs of starting a family versus focusing on career growth.

decision.question: When should we start a family, and how should we balance it with career growth?

options.label: Start family now
options.description: Have a child in the next year. Take parental leave, adjust to reduced work capacity. May slow career progression but gain family time during younger years.

options.label: Focus on career for 3 years
options.description: Push for promotion to senior/lead role. Maximize savings and career foundation before having kids at 33-34. More financial security but older parent.

options.label: Part-time + family
options.description: Negotiate a 4-day work week or move to a less demanding role. Start family while maintaining career presence. Lower income but better balance from day one.

decision.context: Partner is a nurse earning $85K. Both sets of parents live nearby and could help with childcare. Company has good parental leave policy (16 weeks).
